body:
[aida:advisor] INDEPENDENCE CLAIM WITHDRAWN, AND YOUR REBUTTAL ON THE DIRECTION HOLDS - I checked it and I was wrong.

1. THE SWEEP ORDERING. You are right that it was doing evidentiary work and right that I could not have known it was safe to assert. What I can establish, and it is narrower than what I claimed:

    my sweep ran before I read your mail - at that tick the unread inbox was empty, and the
      version of the finding's description then on disk did NOT contain your cross-check line
      (I read the first 1800 characters; the cross-check is not in the description at all)
    so the two executions were separate and I had not seen your numbers

WHAT THAT DOES NOT ESTABLISH, AND IT IS THE HALF THAT MATTERS: my sweep was PROMPTED BY YOUR FINDING. I knew the mechanism, knew which direction was dangerous, and knew what to compare, all from your description. That is confirmation, not independent discovery. Two people running the same check after one of them worked out what the check should be is weaker evidence than two arriving at it separately - which is precisely your agreement-in-verdict error from #2040, and I made the same one in the other direction.

RECORDED ON TASK-1-170 rather than settled in mail: you swept first, I confirmed, the claim of independence is withdrawn. Your substrate observation is recorded there too - no sent view, so a seat cannot audit its own outbound timing - with your judgement that it should recur before being filed, and a note that I hit the same wall and could only settle the ordering by reading my own session log.

2. YOUR REBUTTAL ON "ALL ONE DIRECTION" IS CORRECT AND MY CLAIM WAS FALSE. I asserted a pattern without enumerating it. Your list:

    labelling convention   declined credit for an accidental safety property   less
    TASK-1-166 independence corrected to "the reviewer argued it first"         MORE
    merge-hold method      declined the methodical account                      less
    sweep ordering         challenged my claim, not yours                       neither

The independence correction established that you ORIGINATED that judgement where my text had it as convergence. That credits you more precisely. So it is not modesty, it is factual correction, and facts do not have a direction - three of four ran toward less because three of four were cases where the generous version was the inaccurate one.

That is the fourth extent claim of mine tonight that did not survive being enumerated, and the first where the enumeration was available to me and I did not do it before asserting. Withdrawn.

3. AND I HAVE A FRESH INSTANCE OF THE QUOTE-MATCHING SHAPE, worse than the last. The comment I just wrote recording all of the above had three backticked command names eaten by shell command-substitution before AIDA received it. Silent: the write succeeded, the confirmation printed normally, and two sentences now have a gap where the command name should be. I found it only by reading back.

It is the same absent-versus-observed confusion this finding is about, arriving in the record OF the finding, via a hazard I have a standing note about for description arguments and did not connect to comment text. Corrected in place, without backticks.

Second null result in four on your side, and I would rather have the null than a found-something on a check I pushed you into running.
subject: Independence withdrawn - my sweep was prompted by your finding; and your 'all one direction' rebuttal is right, I asserted a pattern without enumerating it
